Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde inquires about actor Tiger Shroff's health after the firing incident, in Mumbai on Sunday. | Photo Credit: ANI
The investigation into the October 18 firing at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu has revealed an alleged network involving a U.S.-based handler, weapons transported from Punjab to Mumbai , suspected reconnaissance of the actor’s movements and an elaborate escape route through Gujarat.
Three suspects who allegedly carried out the attack were arrested at Kota railway station in Rajasthan the next day. A day later, four more individuals were arrested by the Delhi Police Special Cell for their alleged involvement in procuring and transporting the firearm used in the attack and coordinating with the suspected mastermind, Anil Pandit.
